rows.title: Absolute path service
rows.source: function solve(path){const st=[];for(const p of path.split("/")){if(!p||p===".")continue;if(p===".."&&st.length)st.pop();else st.push(p);}return"/"+st.join("/");}

rounds.answer:
Current marker: INTERVIEW-120-bf2722f122d8d3ba.

The bug is in `src/core.mjs`: `if(p===".."&&st.length)st.pop();else st.push(p);`. When `..` occurs at root, the condition is false and `else st.push(p)` stores it instead of ignoring it, violating the requirement not to go above root.

A smallest valid counterexample is `solve("/..")`: the initial empty segment is skipped; then `..` encounters an empty stack and is pushed. Actual result: `"/.."`. Required result: `"/"`. No implementation changes yet.
